findings.summary: One parameter has to carry three cases, but the brief gives it only two values. The bare doctor 'passes none' and must exempt a complete plan. A vloop run that names no brief is a resume and must validate it. Both pass an empty brief, so runDoctor cannot tell them apart.
findings.evidence: Binding references: 'runPreflight and runDoctor gain it as a parameter; the bare doctor passes none'. V1: 'Validated as today: … a complete plan when vloop run names no brief'. internal/cli/run.go:77-83: briefPath stays "" when no argument is given, then runPreflight is called. The existing callers (internal/cli/doctor_copilot_test.go:48 runPreflight, internal/cli/doctor_second_review_test.go:13,24,38 runDoctor) are told to pass 'no brief', which means a resume in one and the bare doctor in the other.
findings.fix: Pin the form of the parameter. For example: runDoctor gains a planFor func(state brief) bool, or a mode (bare doctor / run naming brief X / run naming none). Or say that runPreflight passes the brief named, with "" for none, and the bare doctor passes a distinct value. Then state what the two existing test callers pass so that their assertions keep today's meaning.

findings.section: Behaviour contract, V2 (order after a session)
findings.summary: The contract says a gate-review session that 'exited non-zero' halts. Today it does not: gateReviewRound halts only on a timeout and goes on to read the verdict. A planner could read this sentence as a new halt, which would contradict 'every other … exit code unchanged'.
findings.evidence: internal/driver/gatereview.go:56-66: refs and git-config checks, then only `if res.TimedOut` halts. There is no res.ExitCode check. The plan session checks both (internal/driver/plan.go:558-563).
findings.fix: Write: 'a plan session that timed out or exited non-zero, or a gate-review session that timed out, has its stray changes reverted (and warned) before its halt; a gate-review session's exit code is judged as today (not at all)'.

findings.section: Worked example, V1 (fixture and reset line)
findings.summary: A run id has no stamp. The fixture's run id 'B20260101-0900-a/<stamp>' fails state/v2's run_id pattern and CheckRunID. It would also make the expected reset line read 'the plan B20260101-0900-a/<stamp> was for …'.
findings.evidence: schemas/state.v2.json:9 run_id pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]*$. internal/driver/safety.go:203-210 requires run_id == brief.RunID(plan.Brief). internal/brief/brief.go:26-28 gives 'B20260101-0900-a'. The existing fixtures use run_id 'B20260101-0900-a' (internal/cli/doctor_test.go:162, cmd/vloop/b2_e2e_test.go:12). The stamp names only the run folder.
findings.fix: Make the run id `B20260101-0900-a`, and make the expected line 'the plan B20260101-0900-a was for docs/briefs/B20260101-0900-a.loop-brief.md — you asked for docs/briefs/B20260101-0910-b.loop-brief.md: resetting and planning fresh'.

findings.summary: The Shape's docs task names only 'the configuration guide's sentence and the session page'. The contract also changes docs/domain/execution/plan.md. The session page's review-brief sentence is conditional ('if it does not already') and not literal, so a 'grep per sentence' gate has no string to grep for. It does not already say it: session.md:23-31 never says that brief is the name. Also, inserting the plan.md sentence 'after a complete one is replaced by the next brief's plan' puts it inside a parenthesis.
findings.evidence: docs/domain/execution/session.md:23-31 (no mention of the name). docs/domain/execution/plan.md:7: '(`state/v2`; … a complete one is replaced by the next brief's plan). *Part of …'. The Shape, task 4 text.
findings.fix: List plan.md in task 4. Write the review-brief sentence literally, for example: 'Its `brief` is the brief's name, its file name without `.md`.' Place the plan.md sentence after the closing parenthesis, or rewrite the parenthesis.

findings.summary: Minor: vloop brief check warns 'path does not resolve: .loop-brief.md' on the V3 parenthesis that explains why '.loop-brief' alone passes.
findings.evidence: vloop brief check on a ready copy under .vloop/tmp/bc/: '! path does not resolve: .loop-brief.md', 'ok, 1 warning(s)'.
findings.fix: Reword so that no backticked token looks like a path, for example 'a brief file whose name is only the suffix passes the command's suffix check'. Or accept the warning knowingly.

decisions: One brief for #110–#112: sound. The files are disjoint and each task leaves the go check green.
Only a complete state/v2 plan of another brief is exempt, and a resume is still validated: agree. It matches the planner's own 'resuming' (internal/driver/plan.go:432) and CheckRunID (safety.go:197).
The bare vloop doctor passes a complete plan and names the plan's brief field: agree. No existing test pins the bare '✓ plan' line for a complete v2 plan.
The guard wraps each plan and gate-review session, not the commit: agree. The base gates run in the working tree right after the plan session (acceptPlan → baseGates).
Planning may write under .vloop/state/ and .vloop/tmp/ (reviewMayWrite), wider than S-4: acceptable. Copilot's per-session files also live under .vloop/tmp/ (agent_copilot.go).
Revert and warn rather than halt on #111: the operator's decision. A revert that fails halts with exit 1 and is not gated: acceptable.

brief-review/v1 tightened in place: the operator's decision. It is a stated exception to B29's 'a published schema does not change', which lives only in B29's rejected alternatives, so no document needs amending. Every kept report (3, 2 of them committed) matches the pattern.
The pattern also rejects '\' and accepts the bare '.loop-brief': agree.
No patterns on the task fields of the other reports: agree.
